questions.question: India won the Men's T20 World Cup 2026 by beating which team in the final?
questions.funFact: It was India's third Men's T20 World Cup title, and they won it playing at home.

questions.question: Which country won the 2026 FIFA World Cup in football?
questions.funFact: It was Spain's second time lifting the football World Cup trophy.

questions.question: Who is the Prime Minister of India (as of 2026)?
questions.funFact: Narendra Modi became India's Prime Minister for a third time in 2024.

questions.question: Chandrayaan-3 landed near the Moon's south pole, a first for any country.
questions.funFact: This success in 2023 made India only the fourth country to land softly on the Moon.

questions.question: India's space agency, which runs the Chandrayaan and Gaganyaan missions, is called ___.
questions.funFact: ISRO is famous around the world for doing amazing space missions at a very low cost.

questions.question: Who is the President of India (as of 2026)?
questions.funFact: Droupadi Murmu is the first President of India from a tribal community.

questions.question: Match each special day to its date.
questions.funFact: Learning a few important national dates helps you follow the news and celebrations all year round.

questions.question: The 2026 Winter Olympics were held in Milan and Cortina, in which country?
questions.funFact: It was the first Winter Olympics officially shared between two host cities.

questions.question: C. P. Radhakrishnan became the Vice President of India in 2025.
questions.funFact: The Vice President also acts as the chairman of the Rajya Sabha.

questions.question: Which team won the IPL cricket title in 2026?
questions.funFact: Royal Challengers Bengaluru won the IPL in 2025 and 2026, two years in a row.

questions.question: International Yoga Day is celebrated every year on 21 ___.
questions.funFact: India suggested the idea of International Yoga Day to the United Nations.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT an Indian space mission?
questions.funFact: Artemis is an American Moon programme; the other three are all Indian missions.

questions.question: The 2025 Nobel Peace Prize was given to a leader from which country?
questions.funFact: The winner, María Corina Machado, was honoured for her peaceful work for her people.

questions.question: India is the most populous country in the world.
questions.funFact: India became the world's most populous country in 2023, passing China.

questions.question: Who is the Chief Minister of Haryana (as of 2026)?
questions.funFact: Haryana, our home state, is led by Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini.
